summary: DEFSEC Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing a 9-to-1 consolidation of common shares effective 12:01 a.m. EDT November 16, 2026, approved by the board November 4, 2026, principally to cure Nasdaq's minimum bid price deficiency. Shares should trade consolidated on TSXV and Nasdaq under existing symbols DFSC/DFSCW; CUSIP 244778205, ISIN CA2447782053. Issued shares fall from 4,593,998 to roughly 510,444, with fractional shares cancelled. Option and warrant terms adjust proportionately; Listed Warrants need 1,890 to buy one share at US$9,450. Final TSXV/Nasdaq approval pending. Watch for approval and post-consolidation price support.
